claims_reconciliation.note: Only 'supported' publishes. 'partially_supported' is withheld, so withheld is 4 + 31 = 35, not 31.

cost_field_definitions.known_cost_usd: OpenAI token cost only. The engine's arithmetic over provider-reported token counts, priced from src/agentic_research/pricing.toml.
cost_field_definitions.openai_model_pricing_complete: Every OpenAI model used in this run had a known price, so no OpenAI call is missing from known_cost_usd. This is the engine's internal cost_is_complete metric, renamed here because in a standalone artifact 'cost is complete' reads as 'this is the total run cost', which it is not.
cost_field_definitions.total_cross_provider_cost_complete: False. Tavily search credits and Hugging Face endpoint compute were not measured, and no provider dashboard was reconciled, so no total run cost is stated anywhere in this artifact.

quote_fidelity.definition: Exact normalised substring match of the extracted quote against the fetched source text. Fuzzy matches are counted separately and are not citable; there were none in this run.
